changelog: - **The uptime job now notices when a marketing host shows the wrong product, and its outage alert can fire again** (#2579). `/api/health` answers the same JSON on every host a container serves, so `uptime.yml` stayed green while `marketing.bcsit-gmbh.de` served the internship landing (the #2428 failure). Every run now also reads `/` and `/imprint` on `marketing.bcsit-gmbh.de` and `.dev`: the `<title>` must name SaleVali and must not say "Internship CRM". The rule is `scripts/marketing-content-probe.mjs` (dependency-free, fetched with a one-file sparse checkout, so the green path still skips `npm ci`); `scripts/test/marketing-content-probe.test.mjs` runs the real CLI against a local server and proves that a wrong title exits 1 with a one-line finding and that green prints nothing. Findings go through the existing `uptime-alert` issue + mail, retried once like the reachability probe, and the issue and mail subject say "Marketing host yanlış ürünü gösteriyor" when content is the only problem. While testing this, the probe step turned out to write `…-> 000EOF` into `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` on a real outage (`$(probe_all)` strips the trailing newline, so the heredoc's closing `EOF` was never on its own line) — the runner rejects that file, so on `main` no incident issue or mail could ever be sent; the newline is now restored. `infra/deploy-prod.sh` runs the same title check against the fresh container as the marketing host after the swap, **warn-only** (curl + sed, no Node on the box; `MARKETING_PROBE=0` skips it). `infra/README.md` § The marketing hosts gains an operator checklist for the parts of #2579 that need prod access (MARKETING org + trial stages, host→org mapping, the retired-name 308).
